verdict.rationale: PlanetScale is an OLTP-oriented platform. Its only relevant evidence is indirect: Postgres read replicas let you move read-heavy work off the primary, and Metal NVMe storage claims high, consistent IOPS. Together these suggest you could run aggregations in-database on a replica rather than exporting, but nothing documents analytical or aggregation performance. Missing for 10: any columnar or analytical engine or OLAP feature, evidence that large-table aggregations run fast enough for dashboards, benchmarks or hands-on reports of analytical workloads, guidance on using replicas for analytics.
